issue.title: test_plugins_pane_install_marked_set_takes_batch_path fails under the parallel scoped lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Intermittent failure of the plugins-browser install batch-path test under parallel load.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by sase-11y.10.1.3.1.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2). While verifying the systemd-scope phase on 2026-09-21, that worker's parallel scoped lane (6464 passed) failed the batch-path test in `tests/ace/tui/test_plugins_browser_pane_install.py`, which then passed when run alone on the same tree.

The sase-11y.10.1.3.1 land agent could not reproduce it: 0/5 runs of that file together with `test_plugins_browser_pane_uninstall.py` and `test_usage_header.py` under `-n 4` (45 passed each), and the node also passed in a full `just test-scoped` lane (15374 passed). The test stubs `_restart_tui` and waits with `page.wait_for(lambda _s: bool(executed) and bool(restart_calls))`, so it does not reach the epic's `restart_after_update` / scheduler service-proc path. The epic did not cause this. Observed fail rate so far: 1 failure under parallel load, 0 serial.

The reporter did not record the exact node ID. The test-name match to "batch-path" is `test_plugins_pane_install_marked_set_takes_batch_path`.

evidence.note: Same root cause, two sibling nodes: during the sase-11y.10.1.7 landing's escalated full test lane (just test-scoped, 44343 passed, host load ~50) tests/ace/tui/test_plugins_browser_pane_install.py::test_plugins_pane_install_confirm_executes_and_restarts and tests/ace/tui/test_plugins_browser_pane_uninstall.py::test_plugins_pane_uninstall_confirm_executes_and_restarts both failed with 'wait_for() timed out after 5.0s' on page.wait_for(lambda _s: bool(restart_calls)) after modal.action_confirm(). Both files then passed 3/3 (21 passed each run) on the same tree at load ~46 when run by file. Neither file was touched by epic sase-11y.10.1.7; the confirm->restart wait is stubbed at _restart_tui and never reaches the scheduler service-proc path. Remediation is the same as this bead: the plugin-pane confirm/restart waits are too tight for full-suite xdist load.

payload.entry: Same-family evidence (sase-11y.11 land agent, 2026-09-21, workspace sase_32 at master f330e2b94 plus landing edits): one parallel just test-scoped lane (4 workers, 40 min, 16819 passed) failed four sibling plugins-pane restart tests: test_plugins_browser_pane_install.py::test_plugins_pane_install_confirm_executes_and_restarts, test_plugins_browser_pane_uninstall.py::test_plugins_pane_uninstall_confirm_executes_and_restarts, test_plugins_browser_pane_update.py::test_plugins_pane_update_confirm_executes_and_writes_receipt and ::test_plugins_pane_editable_update_uses_dev_preview_and_restart. All four passed when rerun together serially on the same tree. That suggests a shared load-sensitive wait in the plugins-pane confirm/restart tests, not only the batch-path node.
